race.comment: CRYPTION'S DESIRE (1) goes on top after just missing to SWANFELS last time at Ipswich. He didn't have the cleanest of runs through there and now the winner with a good pull at the weights. Can get the job done third-up. SWANFELS (5) has the direct form line, having beaten CRYPTION'S DESIRE as favourite last time. Handles the wet and strips rock-hard fit with Moor sticking. Have to take seriously. PACIERA (2) is chasing the hat-trick, and the 2kg claim gets her in well. First look at the mile is the only query. SORRENTI (3) was much better last start when stretching to the mile, knuckling down strongly late to grab third. Looks even better stepping out to the mile and is among the winning chances.
